## Acapulco: a tourist centre in Mexico

Acapulco is known as Mexico's 'nightlife capital', a city of entertainment, shows, casinos and restaurants. One centre of tourist activity is the Pie de la Cuesta lagoon, with beautiful beaches and restaurants on the city's northern edge. The Spanish Fort of San Diego (17th–18th centuries) in the historic centre and the municipal Zócalo Square, where you can see the beautiful Cathedral of Our Lady of Solitude, are gems of colonial-era cultural heritage, admired for their elegant architecture.

You can also watch the famous cliff divers at La Quebrada (45 m) and the colourful 'Fiesta Mexicana' show. Enjoy a boat trip with dinner and a show, or explore the city's well-known nightclubs, restaurants and other attractions.

## Active recreation in Acapulco

Acapulco's coastal waters are rich in marine life. More than 20 municipal beaches line the shores of its beautiful natural bay, with options for different tastes (all beaches are open and admission is free). Popular places to swim include Caleta, Pie de la Cuesta and Caletilla beaches in Old Acapulco, as well as the fashionable Condesa Beach. You can hire a fishing boat or a glass-bottomed boat and travel to the resort island of Roqueta, home to a large zoo, or towards the Las Playas peninsula to see the submerged altar of the Virgin of Guadalupe.

Pale sand, warm water and tropical vegetation make the coastline a peaceful place to pause between flights. Accommodation and transfers depend on the terms of the specific tour.
